purpose: Measure the last un-mined object identified by the second-pass search: the influence support of the key-indexed function f_P(K) = E_K(P), member D3 of the fourth object class. Every other member was a repackaging or out of envelope.
measured_by: dispatching session (Bash), coordinator-side corroboration - NOT independent validation
instrument: GOAL-AES-001 BATCH-001 pinned harness aes_reduced.py, sha256 2c76f3e5db83ec2500ce1010a392a135869d8b9dd1a534af817e06f15babb447
method: For each of the 128 key bits, flip it and record which of the 128 ciphertext bits change. Density = fraction of the 128x128 influence matrix that is set, averaged over 8 random (key, plaintext) pairs per round count, seed 20260801. Sparse means exploitable structure; 0.5 means saturated and indistinguishable from a random function.
finding: The influence support is sparse at one round, partial at two, and SATURATED FROM ROUND THREE ONWARD - flat at 0.499 +/- 0.002 against a random-function baseline of 0.5, with no drift across rounds 3 to 10. The object is dead at round 3 of a 10-round cipher.
verdict: D3 is closed. With it, every object class the two searches identified is now closed: the enumerative class by the O-3 amortization ceiling (max gain 7.64 bits), the structural classes by the measured depth wall (integral dead at round 5), the algebraic class by the degree of regularity (2^434 to 2^859 against 2^128), and this one by measured saturation at round 3.
not_established: This measures BIT-LEVEL influence density only. A saturated influence matrix does not preclude finer structure inside it - a biased or otherwise structured dependence could exist at a resolution this probe does not see.
8 trials per round count is enough to separate 0.077 from 0.500; it is not a distribution and resolves nothing at the third decimal.
Closing the classes these two searches IDENTIFIED is not the same as closing all classes. Both searches state this themselves; no impossibility claim is made or implied.
Asserts nothing about AES security at any round count. No comparison against published cryptanalysis in either direction.
Coordinator-side corroboration from a session sharing the campaign's single model under 0137a051; not independent validation.
